reviews.author: Lisa Oleksik
reviews.text: David was incredible!!! Very friendly and polite. Had to wait no time at all for him to come (30 minutes maybe at 9:30 pm on a friday). Reasonable price as well. Will definitely recommend them!!!

reviews.author: Johnny Woodard
reviews.text: He gave me a tow after midnight when I had a blowout and no spare, and didn't complain despite the car I was driving not having a tow hook. His fee was also a good bit less than what the OnStar default towing service was quoting. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ashley Key
reviews.text: Amazing service! A man of his word!! And very reasonable! I pray that his business continues to flourish another 20 years!

reviews.author: Charlie Holley
reviews.text: You wont be disappointed using this guy. He is a great asset to our county. Dependable, honest, and easy on the pocketbook
